# Sunland Dental Care

> Implant-focused, minimally invasive dental practice in Sunland, CA (Los Angeles), led by Dr. Mahvash Emami, DDS since 1991. Flagship offer: a complete single dental implant — consultation, 3D imaging, guided surgery, and final crown — for $2,000 fixed, no hidden fees, all performed in-house.

## Key facts
- Practice: Sunland Dental Care, established 1991 (same location for 35 years)
- Dentist: Dr. Mahvash Emami, DDS (also listed as Mahvash Emamisadr / Emami-Sadr) — implantology specialist, 40 years of clinical experience, thousands of implants placed
- Address: 7902 Foothill Blvd, Sunland, CA 91040, USA
- Phone: (818) 353-5520 · Email: dremami@sunlanddentalcare.com
- Hours: Monday–Friday 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM; closed weekends
- Service area: Sunland-Tujunga and a 50-mile radius across Greater Los Angeles, including Shadow Hills, Lake View Terrace, Sun Valley, La Crescenta-Montrose, La Cañada Flintridge, Glendale, Burbank, Pasadena, San Fernando, North Hollywood, Santa Clarita, and the San Fernando Valley
- Signature pricing: complete single dental implant $2,000 fixed (consultation + 3D imaging + guided surgery + restoration); typical Los Angeles single-implant cost often exceeds $5,000
- Approach: minimally invasive / conservative dentistry; 3D-guided implant surgery; gums-first hygiene ("the mouth is the gateway to the body")
- Services: dental implants, full-arch/All-on-4, periodontal therapy and gum surgery (in-house), sedation for implant placement, cosmetic dentistry (veneers, whitening, smile makeovers), Invisalign and orthodontics, dentures, root canals, general and family dentistry, emergency care
- New patients: accepted; Dr. Emami personally reviews every new-patient consultation
